description: This PHP class, tlIssueTracker, manages issue tracker configurations within the TestLink project. It handles CRUD operations, system integration types, linking to test projects, environment checks, and XML configuration validation for different issue tracking systems like Bugzilla, Mantis, Jira, GitLab, and others.
external_files: TestLink core classes (implied by parent superclass tlObject)
Database interface (methods like exec_query, get_recordset, prepare_string, insert_id, error_msg)

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: Main class managing issue tracker data and operations, supporting CRUD, linking, system management, environment checking, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, loads system types, and sets the database connection.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Retrieves system configurations filtered by enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping of system codes to their type and interface description.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Provides the class name of the implementation interface for a given issue tracker type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the entity specification array for issue tracker objects.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new issue tracker configuration after validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing issue tracker configuration, checking for duplicates and XML validity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an issue tracker configuration if not linked to any test project.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves an issue tracker by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: Fetches an issue tracker based on a specified attribute, either by ID or name.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input object data for safe database storage.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Associates an issue tracker with a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes association between an issue tracker and a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves test projects linked to a specific issue tracker.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Fetches all linkages between test projects and issue trackers.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all issue trackers with optional environment checks and link count.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Gets the test project linked to a given issue tracker ID.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Returns the interface object for a linked issue tracker, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the issue tracker can establish a connection.

methods.name: checkXMLCfg
methods.description: Validates an XML configuration string for correct structure.
